items.definition:
a duct for smoke and waste gases
The chimney flue needed to be cleaned before winter.

an area of open land around a city, on which building is restricted
The city council voted to protect the greenbelt from development.

the inability to make a decision quickly
His indecision cost them the opportunity.

a very small island
We saw a tiny islet in the distance.

a chemical element
Krypton is a noble gas.

a slow-growing plant that typically forms a low crustlike, leaflike, or branching growth on rocks, walls, and trees
Lichen often grows on old trees.

a dye used as a chemical indicator
Litmus paper is used to test pH levels.

a bullfighter whose task is to kill the bull
The matador faced the bull bravely.

A crystalline compound with a minty smell.
The cough drops had a strong menthol flavor.

A single unvaried tone of voice or sound.
The speaker's monotone voice made it hard to stay awake.

A strange or peculiar person, thing, or quality.
The old house was full of interesting oddities.

The act or process of decorating; decorative elements.
The building's facade featured elaborate ornamentation.

An excessive or disproportionate reaction.
Her anger was an overreaction to a minor mistake.

A rapid succession of light sounds; glib or rapid talk.
We listened to the gentle patter of rain on the roof.

resistance or negative reaction to a change or new idea
The new policy faced significant pushback from employees.

a defensive wall of a castle or fortified city
The ancient city was protected by high ramparts.

the bending of light as it passes from one medium to another
The refraction of light through water makes objects appear distorted.

a sum of money sent, especially as a payment
He sent a monthly remittance to his family abroad.

a woman who sews for a living
The seamstress carefully mended the torn dress.

a person skilled at presenting shows
The circus showman captivated the audience with his charisma.

a mark made by a liquid splashing
There was a splatter of mud on the car door.

something intended to be discarded after use
We should reduce our use of throwaway plastic items.

a long bridge-like structure, typically a series of arches, carrying a road or railway across a valley or other low ground.
The train crossed the old stone viaduct high above the river.

a small songbird.
The tiny warbler sang sweetly from the tree branch.

a system of reservoirs, conduits, and pumping machinery for supplying water to a town or district.
The city's waterworks ensure a clean supply of drinking water.

the state of being annoyed or made worse.
The traffic caused a lot of aggravation.

inflammation of the appendix
He was rushed to the hospital with acute appendicitis.

suitability or correctness
The appropriateness of his remarks was questioned by the audience.

a minor street
They found a small cafe hidden down a backstreet.

a liquid formed by condensation
The cold pipe produced a lot of condensate.

a genre of science fiction
Blade Runner is a classic example of cyberpunk.

a person who abandons their duty, especially in the military
The soldier was declared a deserter after leaving his post.

a person whose job is to calculate the cost of something
The estimator provided a quote for the construction work.

a plant root used in traditional medicine
Many people drink ginseng tea for its health benefits.

a firm and uncompromising approach
The company decided to play hardball in the negotiations.

a stone slab at the head of a grave
The old headstone was covered in moss.

The quality of being easily annoyed
Lack of sleep can lead to increased irritability.

a small, two-winged insect
We were constantly swatting away midges during our hike.

a small bite or sip
He took a quick nip of the strong coffee.

a tall, four-sided, narrow tapering monument
The ancient Egyptians erected many impressive obelisks.

a strange or eccentric person
He's a bit of an oddball, but he's harmless.

a foreigner or stranger
The villagers were wary of the outlander who arrived in their quiet town.

the state or quality of lasting or remaining unchanged indefinitely
They sought permanence in their relationship.

a very steep cliff
The hikers stood at the edge of the precipice, gazing at the valley below.

a type of wine, pink in color
We ordered a bottle of chilled rosé for dinner.

a small amphibian with a lizard-like appearance
The salamander hid under a damp log.

a small, light, straight knife used by surgeons
The surgeon carefully picked up the scalpel.

a cavity in the ground, especially in limestone bedrock, caused by water erosion
A large sinkhole suddenly appeared in the middle of the road.

a woman who practices magic; a witch
The brave knight faced the evil sorceress in her dark castle.

a journey into outer space
Human spaceflight continues to push the boundaries of exploration.

a person who spends money
She's a big spender when it comes to clothes.

a person who buys and sells stocks and shares for clients
My uncle works as a stockbroker in the city.

a particularly powerful mainframe computer
Scientists use a supercomputer to model climate change.

the quality or state of being tranquil; calmness
She found peace and tranquillity by the lake.

the branch of mathematics dealing with the relations of the sides and angles of triangles
Trigonometry is an essential part of advanced mathematics.

an ornamental addition or a piece cut off
The dress had a beautiful lace trimming.

a strike; a sudden departure
The workers staged a walkout to protest the low wages.

a person who works in a forest, a lumberjack
The woodman chopped down trees all day.

the witty use of words
His speech was full of clever wordplay and puns.

the state of being watchful and ready
The pilot's alertness prevented a serious accident.

a remote, undeveloped area
They went hiking deep into the backcountry.

the front line of a battle
The soldiers advanced towards the battlefront.

a prickly seed case or flower head
My dog came back covered in burs.

a person who accompanies and looks after another
A teacher will act as a chaperone for the school trip.
